landing.headline: Everything about school life, in one place.
landing.subheadline: Schools manage students, grades, attendance and events. Parents follow their children's progress on the web and on their phone.
landing.featureSchoolsBody: Import your students, tailor fields and modules to your school, and keep everything up to date.
landing.featureParentsBody: Grades, attendance, teacher notes and events — visible as soon as the school publishes them.
landing.featureMobileBody: The same account works in the browser and in the mobile app.
landing.featurePrivacyBody: Every school's data is isolated, and parents see only their own children.
